title: Post-correction recorded-balance convergence classification
decision: Implement discovery Option B: a pure convergence classifier over canonical FOOD-006W with explicit balance-comparison fields for auditability.
input: Exactly one FOOD-006W correction-movement evidence-inclusion verification result.
canonicalChain: FOOD-006W verified proves every canonical correction movement is represented by bounded exact-SKU evidence at or before validated cutoff H on its exact batch.
FOOD-006W retains canonical FOOD-006V verified provenance.
FOOD-006V retains the fresh validated FOOD-006P recorded balance and canonical FOOD-006R bookkeeping reconciliation against the exact historical FOOD-006Q observation.
FOOD-006X performs no new authoritative read and does not recompute correction allocation arithmetic.

outcomes.converged: FOOD-006W is verified and embedded canonical bookkeeping FOOD-006R is agreement with zero variance and exact counted/recorded equality.
outcomes.not-converged: FOOD-006W is verified but embedded canonical bookkeeping FOOD-006R remains nonzero after all correction movements are included.
outcomes.no-correction-required: Canonical FOOD-006W no-correction agreement is preserved without inventing a correction-cycle convergence claim.
outcomes.ineligible: Canonical FOOD-006W invalid, ineligible or missing-evidence cannot receive convergence certification.
outcomes.invalid: Malformed, tampered or noncanonical FOOD-006W provenance is rejected.

safeClaim: At authoritative exact-SKU cutoff H, every canonical correction movement from the completed correction bundle is represented in the validated recorded-balance evidence, and that recorded balance equals the exact historical caller-asserted physical count.
notConvergedSafeClaim: Every canonical correction movement is represented at or before validated cutoff H, but the recorded balance at H does not equal the exact historical caller-asserted physical count.
doesNotEstablish: that correction movements alone caused convergence
truth or completeness of the historical physical count
